source: levels: NIJ Standard-0101.06 (July 2008), section 2 'NIJ Body Armor Classification', velocities for new and unworn armor; bullet diameters from the same standard's test-bullet table (nominal bullet diameter column).
design_note: materials, enchantment_bonus and blunt_damage_fraction are game design, not measurements. Armor is treated as aramid acting like a weak NERA: it takes a fixed energy per area out of the bullet (the largest E/A among its level's test threats, times the enchantment multiplier). Diamond and netherite stand for plate-backed vests (NIJ III / IV). enchantment_bonus follows vanilla's ratio: Projectile Protection counts twice what Protection does against projectiles (4% / 8% per level). wear (design): a hit takes 0.2 of a piece's ballistic integrity per unit of the bullet's E/A relative to the piece's threshold (a bullet at the threshold: 5 hits to empty), and any piece hit 5 times stops nothing.
